[chat-core] Drop ContactPresenceFilter::Invisible (contacts never invisible)
Spec (80ae683): draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md L520: "`presence` (String, optional, server-set): Last known presence state: `\"online\"`, `\"away\"`, `\"busy\"`, or `\"offline\"`. A contact whose own presence is `\"invisible\"` appears as `\"offline\"`."
Code: crate-jmap-chat-client/src/types.rs:30-31 (Invisible variant); crate-jmap-chat-client/src/types.rs:48 (TryFrom maps Presence::Invisible)
Now: The client filter enum offers a ChatContact presence value the spec no longer allows. The type is already orphaned public API. The server side is correct: Peer/presence rejects invisible (chat-federation-server/src/presence.rs:197-205), and the outbound and ephemeral paths map invisible to offline (presence.rs:119, chat-server/src/ephemeral.rs:224).
Change: Resolve as part of JMAP-y7iy: either remove the type, or at least remove Invisible and make TryFrom reject Presence::Invisible."}
